doc: Boss script for the lava creature (effects named M Gil) fought on a circular arena of radius 600 with eight magma pools. It alternates between a surface phase, where it walks to the ring, slams the ground with shockwaves and roars out fireballs, and a magma phase, where it dives into the nearest pool, fires flame volleys and surfaces to rest. Below 50% and 20% life it gains more flame shots. Its skin color heats and cools with the phase, and event 570 plays on its death.
